scope: Component/native fixture evidence is not a full acceptance or release claim.

scenarios.scenario: Fresh installation, no Google account
scenarios.reason: Local offline RxDB/image/export component covered; full UI/remote-activity boundary still needs browser/platform coverage.

scenarios.scenario: Successful Google connection with required platform permissions
scenarios.reason: Operating-mode/account-generation lifecycle is not implemented yet.

scenarios.scenario: Google connection fails or is cancelled
scenarios.reason: Operating-mode/account-generation lifecycle is not implemented yet.

scenarios.scenario: Browser denies rendezvous host permission
scenarios.reason: Operating-mode/account-generation lifecycle is not implemented yet.

scenarios.scenario: Login with previously unbound local boards
scenarios.reason: Connect-time durable disclosure enrolls previously unbound local boards via an explicit allowBinding gate; bounded boards and their local data are retained. Full UI/account-generation lifecycle and live-account coverage remain.

scenarios.scenario: Explicit logout
scenarios.reason: Private causal recovery component now passes this regression; broader transport/lifecycle acceptance remains incomplete.

scenarios.scenario: Switch from account A to account B
scenarios.reason: Established durable board/account bindings are enforced and an unbound local board is never uploaded to another connected account through reconciliation; binding enrollment for previously unbound boards happens through the disclosed connect gate. Full UI/account-generation lifecycle acceptance remains Job 11.

scenarios.scenario: Restart or resume with an existing account connection
scenarios.reason: Operating-mode/account-generation lifecycle is not implemented yet.

scenarios.scenario: A user's original device is permanently unavailable; a fresh device has only Google login
scenarios.reason: Component and native Chromium restore private history, images, conflicts, drafts and resolutions after source-profile destruction with no peers or legacy discovery. Google HTTP is simulated; full platform/lifecycle acceptance remains open.

scenarios.scenario: Recovered private data includes a previously signed shared-board copy
scenarios.reason: Signed bytes and detached causal proofs restore without authority keys, pins or grants. Complete trusted authority recovery and live Google remain unverified.

scenarios.scenario: Drive acknowledges current state and attachments; no peers online; signaling healthy
scenarios.reason: The four contract labels with approved precedence (Local only, Conflict requires resolution, Synchronization pending, Synced) are implemented as a tested resolver: src/sync/boardStatus.ts. UI wiring into the sidebar status surface and live peer/acknowledgement integration remain.

scenarios.scenario: Peers receive edits but Drive is unavailable
scenarios.reason: Unified, causally acknowledged user-visible status is not implemented yet.

scenarios.scenario: Drive succeeds but signaling is unavailable
scenarios.reason: Unified, causally acknowledged user-visible status is not implemented yet.

scenarios.scenario: An unresolved conflict is safely persisted remotely
scenarios.reason: Private history durably preserves unresolved variants and manual drafts; conflict panel remains visible after backup. Unified synchronization status remains pending.

scenarios.scenario: Same change delivered twice or by both Drive and WebRTC
scenarios.reason: Private persistence and authenticated peer history deduplicate content IDs, offer only missing changes and scope receipts by destination. Complete mode/platform acceptance remains open.

scenarios.scenario: A change demonstrably descends from the current variant
scenarios.reason: Proven descendants outrank reversed document clocks in private history and the existing RxDB conflict handler; native same/different-account WebRTC tests pass. Full lifecycle/platform acceptance remains open.

scenarios.scenario: Two devices edit different cards from the same board state
scenarios.reason: Private history and authenticated peer exchange preserve independent offline card edits; full cross-platform/recovery lifecycle acceptance remains incomplete.

scenarios.scenario: Two devices change independent fields of one card with a known common ancestor
scenarios.reason: Engine creates unsigned previews for independent title/content/display-mode fields with a unique common ancestor; originals persist. Authorized publication and cross-document invariants await integration.

scenarios.scenario: Devices make the same value change from a common ancestor
scenarios.reason: Peer exchange retains concurrent text branches and transfers a newly signed reviewed resolution. Historical authorization, offline policy and full platform acceptance remain open.

scenarios.scenario: Devices change the same text field to different values
scenarios.reason: Signed offline text variants survive native two-browser reconnect and require explicit resolution. Full offline/historical permission acceptance remains open.

scenarios.scenario: Concurrent structural edits, incompatible template/type changes, or insufficient ancestry
scenarios.reason: Engine preserves unknown ancestry, structural changes and incompatible project changes conservatively. Board-wide invariants and transport intake remain pending.

scenarios.scenario: Concurrent card/board ordering changes
scenarios.reason: Engine conservatively retains incompatible orderKey changes as conflicts. Deterministic board ordering and transport integration remain pending.

scenarios.scenario: A stale device reconnects after a conflict exists
scenarios.reason: Missing ancestry remains retained; bounded peer exchange accepts parent/child arrival order and reprojects after new records. Complete lifecycle/platform acceptance remains open.

scenarios.scenario: Clock skew, clock rollback or delayed delivery
scenarios.reason: Ancestry outranks reversed document clocks through native WebRTC/RxDB and private persistence. Complete credential/sleep/account lifecycle remains open.

scenarios.scenario: An authorized deletion with no concurrent content change
scenarios.reason: Private and peer history retain causal tombstones and source proofs. Complete shared-board deletion/permission acceptance remains open.

scenarios.scenario: Deletion concurrent with an edit
scenarios.reason: Authenticated peer exchange retains edit/delete branches; private history and global UI preserve hidden-board evidence. Board-wide deletion resolution and offline permission acceptance remain open.

scenarios.scenario: A replica acknowledges an edit and later observes an authorized descendant deletion
scenarios.reason: Retained history prevents ancestor resurrection and catches up after reconnect/database loss. Complete lifecycle/platform acceptance remains open.

scenarios.scenario: User removes a board from their own list
scenarios.reason: Account-only removal/preference handling is tested under fixtures; independent-path deletion/account-binding migration remains incomplete.

scenarios.scenario: User deletes a shared board
scenarios.reason: Persistent edit/delete and concurrent resolution semantics are not implemented yet.

scenarios.scenario: Authorized editor resolves a card/content conflict
scenarios.reason: Native signed offline authors exchange an explicit authorized two-parent resolution, retaining source variants. Private backups recover the proof without authority transfer. Board-wide and historical permission cases remain open.

scenarios.scenario: Another change or another resolution arrives concurrently
scenarios.reason: Stale reviews and concurrent resolutions remain retained; separate personal drafts stay local/private. Transported history is authenticated, but complete historical/offline permissions remain open.

scenarios.scenario: Viewer, revoked device or unknown identity attempts resolution
scenarios.reason: Resolution rejects viewers, expired/revoked/missing grants, foreign-authority variants, cross-board requests and editor board-deletion decisions. Durable offline-role policies and transport-level resolution acceptance remain incomplete.

scenarios.scenario: Same Google identity on a new device
scenarios.reason: Verified-identity fixture and native same-account enrollment work in opt-in mode; automatic Connected lifecycle and original-device-independent authority renewal remain incomplete.

scenarios.scenario: Different Google identity with an explicit board invitation
scenarios.reason: Explicit email invitations issue root-signed device grants; native separate-account fixture passes. Target Google-required socket admission and full platform coverage remain incomplete.

scenarios.scenario: Valid Google login without board membership
scenarios.reason: Uninvited identities see no board; real local sockets reject nonmembers and cross-board proofs. Target default mode and Google-required WS gate remain incomplete.

scenarios.scenario: Grant expires or freshness cannot be checked while a previously authorized editor is offline
scenarios.reason: Expired-grant card edits and buffered structural commands are durable local-only pending work with original device/base; private-Drive backup/restore of held work is component-tested. Full UI acceptance and command-type breadth remain incomplete.

scenarios.scenario: Fresh authorization confirms the editor still has access
scenarios.reason: Original-device pending card edits are admitted under renewed grants with stable operation identity and retained concurrent branches; other commands and full browser lifecycle remain incomplete.

scenarios.scenario: Removal/downgrade is confirmed before pending work is admitted
scenarios.reason: Verified newer grants persist downgrade/removal, block publication and further edits, and retain private pending work; full UI/account-lifecycle coverage remains incomplete.

scenarios.scenario: An offline author claims their change predates revocation
scenarios.reason: Exact locally verified historical bytes remain usable under retained local evidence; new timestamp claims fail. Transferable admission evidence and fresh-peer transitive recovery remain incomplete.

scenarios.scenario: Viewer or device with no established editing entitlement goes offline or logs out
scenarios.reason: Viewer permissions survive restart and transport stop; signed recovered boards without local entitlement fail closed. Full browser/logout acceptance remains incomplete.

scenarios.scenario: Original authority browser is unavailable
scenarios.reason: Explicitly owner-authorized sealed-root recovery works after permanent profile/key loss and service restart, natively (different and same account) and in components; legacy-client treatment and Google-verified live deployment remain for Jobs 11/12.

scenarios.scenario: Claimed authority differs from an existing pin; metadata/signature is invalid
scenarios.reason: Current pins/signatures and invalid mutation paths fail closed; target unified recovery/actionable status and migration still require work.

scenarios.scenario: Missing Google service proof, forged/replayed credentials, cross-board signals or quota abuse
scenarios.reason: Google-required public service admission is single-use and session/room/device-bound, with independent board authorization and tested resource quotas. Proxy/TCP, live Google and measured capacity remain unverified.

scenarios.scenario: Drive fails while authorized WebRTC is available
scenarios.reason: Opt-in native Chromium fixture covers independent Drive/signaling outages and an actual process kill/reopen. Full scheduler, actual sleep, all platforms and live Google remain unverified.

scenarios.scenario: Signaling or peer transport fails while Drive is available
scenarios.reason: Opt-in native Chromium fixture covers independent Drive/signaling outages and an actual process kill/reopen. Full scheduler, actual sleep, all platforms and live Google remain unverified.

scenarios.scenario: Both remote channels fail
scenarios.reason: Complete transport-independent restart/resume recovery is not established yet.

scenarios.scenario: Process ends after a successful local save but before upload/acknowledgement
scenarios.reason: Journal crash-window tests and native process restart preserve local history; fresh-device recovery restores completed private backups. Full scheduler/platform crash acceptance remains incomplete.

scenarios.scenario: Remote write succeeds but its acknowledgement is lost
scenarios.reason: Lost private-upload acknowledgements and interrupted peer transfers retain pending data. New peer sessions offer again despite old receipts; complete scheduler/platform acceptance remains open.

scenarios.scenario: New local edit occurs during an upload/download
scenarios.reason: New edits during history and compatibility uploads retain pending state; no account HTTP holds the local materialization queue. Full account-generation lifecycle remains incomplete.

scenarios.scenario: Device sleeps, resumes, or receives repeated connectivity/focus events
scenarios.reason: Opt-in native Chromium fixture covers independent Drive/signaling outages and an actual process kill/reopen. Full scheduler, actual sleep, all platforms and live Google remain unverified.

scenarios.scenario: Repeated transient errors or service throttling
scenarios.reason: Controlled-clock seeded-jitter test verifies existing bounded request retries. A durable cross-channel recovery scheduler with the approved defaults is not implemented yet.

scenarios.scenario: Permanent authorization denial, invalid trust, or rejected scope
scenarios.reason: Remote-list failure preserves local content/images and markers; authorization/quota scheduler behavior remains incomplete.

scenarios.scenario: Image metadata arrives before its bytes
scenarios.reason: Expired-grant and independent-path attachments: image metadata before bytes keeps the reference and pending attachment; peer DataChannel transfer verifies the hash before storage; private appDataFolder assets persist immutably. Full browser/Android and out-of-order chunk recovery acceptance remains.

scenarios.scenario: Two different users are never online together and have no intervening authorized peer
scenarios.reason: Complete transport-independent restart/resume recovery is not established yet.

scenarios.scenario: State, conflict evidence or an attachment fails durable storage
scenarios.reason: Complete transport-independent restart/resume recovery is not established yet.
